correctness.rationale: The five possible quotient projections yield an exhaustive four-type classification of subalgebras; maximal embedded inclusions are codimension one. Counting their multiplicities gives exact recurrences for complete chain totals, with base cases, and weights of the first quotient drop. The weighted sum has a constant leading term and summable error, proving the uniform limit in total variation. A standalone all-subspace checker independently enumerated finite small cases (2,0–3), (3,0–2), and (5,1), all matching. Finite checks do not prove all fields or the limiting theorem; the algebraic argument does.

A broader uninspected general flag-enumeration theorem remains a possible originality risk.
